explanation: Epsom salt is chemically known as magnesium sulphate heptahydrate.

question_text: Which statement is/are true about ammonium chloride? i) Ammonium chloride is assayed by Volhard's method. ii) Ammonium chloride is assayed by acid-base titration. iii) Ammonium chloride is a reflux expectorant. iv) Ammonium chloride is an antidote for cyanide poisoning.
explanation: Ammonium chloride is assayed by acid-base titration (back titration), used as an expectorant, and can be assayed via methods including modified approaches, while cyanide uses specific antidotes like sodium nitrite.

question_text: The calcium compound used topically in the treatment of burns by hydrofluoric acid :
explanation: Calcium gluconate gel is the standard topical treatment for hydrofluoric acid burns to bind fluoride ions.

question_text: Substance added as a stabilizer for aqueous solutions of mild silver protein :
explanation: Disodium edetate (EDTA) is added as a chelating stabilizer to prevent precipitation and oxidation in mild silver protein solutions.

question_text: The concentration of iodine in strong iodine solution I.P. is :
explanation: Strong iodine solution I.P. (Lugol's solution) contains 5% w/v iodine and 10% w/v potassium iodide.
Tartar emetic is chemically antimony potassium tartrate.

question_text: Spirit of salt is the synonym for :
explanation: Hydrochloric acid is historically known by the synonym 'spirit of salt'.

question_text: The content of chlorine in chlorinated lime should be not less than :
explanation: Chlorinated lime (bleaching powder) must contain not less than 30% w/w of available chlorine.

question_text: Inorganic compound which is used as a dentine desensitiser is:
explanation: Strontium chloride is widely used in toothpaste formulations as a dentine desensitizing agent.

question_text: A tooth paste contains stannous fluoride and calcium pyrophosphate along with other formulation constituents. Choose the correct statement out of the followings

options.A: Stannous fluoride is an anticaries agent while calcium pyrophosphate is a dentifrice
options.B: Stannous fluoride is a dentifrice while calcium pyrophosphate is a desensitizing agent
options.C: Stannous fluoride is a desensitizing agent while calcium pyrophosphate is an anticaries agent
options.D: Both are dentifrices while calcium pyrophosphate is additionally a desensitizing agent

explanation: Stannous fluoride provides fluoride for caries prevention, whereas calcium pyrophosphate acts as an abrasive/polishing agent (dentifrice component).

question_text: Hydrogen peroxide solution (20 volumes) is used topically as a mild antiseptic. It is mainly used for cleaning of wounds which could be due to some of the following actions of hydrogen peroxide. [P] Astringent action [Q] Nascent hydrogen releasing action [R] Oxidizing action [S] Mechanical cleansing action Choose the correct statements for the use of hydrogen peroxide as cleaning agent for wounds
explanation: Hydrogen peroxide cleanses wounds via its oxidizing action and mechanical effervescence/cleansing action from oxygen gas release.

question_text: Boric acid is a weak acid ($	ext{pKa } 9.19$) which cannot be titrated with a standard solution of sodium hydroxide using phenolphthalein as indicator. This titration becomes possible on addition of glycerol due to one of the following reactions. Choose the correct reaction

options.A: Boric acid becomes boronic acid on reaction with glycerol
options.B: Boric acid gives a monoprotic tetravalent boron ester with glycerol
options.C: Boric acid gives a tribasic acid on reaction with glycerol
options.D: Two boric acid molecules combine to give an anhydride in presence of glycerol

explanation: Glycerol complexes with boric acid to form a stronger, stable chelated monobasic acid complex that can be titrated using phenolphthalein.

question_text: An iron compound used as heaminatic agent must meet two requirements i.e. it should be biologically available and be non-irritating. Which of the following compounds meet the above two requirements most closely
explanation: Ferric ammonium citrate is a well-tolerated, bioavailable oral iron supplement with minimized gastric irritation compared to inorganic ferric salts.

question_text: Iodine-131 as sodium iodide solution is used as a radiopharmaceutical for diagnostic and therapeutic purposes. Its usage is dependent on the release of the following emissions: [P] Alpha particles [Q] Positrons [R] Beta emission [S] Gamma radiation Choose the correct combination of statements
explanation: Iodine-131 undergoes radioactive decay by emitting beta particles (for therapeutic tissue destruction) and gamma rays (for imaging/diagnostics).

explanation: Madrell's salt (insoluble sodium metaphosphate) is commonly used as a polishing agent in dentifrices.

question_text: Which of the following metal has no therapeutic use ?
explanation: Lead is a toxic heavy metal with no approved therapeutic use in modern medicine.
